premise: Astronomer can't sleep in the long Moon night; she visits the glowing greenhouse, where the seedling reaches for the light, and tells it a story until she falls asleep.
inspiration: Andersen's 'The Flax' (a plant's quiet life and the stories it hears), turned: a night watch where the plant listens and the storyteller sleeps.
lesson: Company makes a long night shorter.

en-US.title: The Greenhouse Glow
en-US.text: {canvas:nightfall 16s} The Moon night was long, {astronomer:enter} {astronomer:face sad} and Astronomer couldn't sleep. [sighs] {astronomer:shake} She tried counting stars. She tried counting craters. Then she saw a soft glow across the plain. {greenhouse:enter} It was the greenhouse, lit {greenhouse:live hold} up violet in the dark. {astronomer:go to greenhouse} She tiptoed over. Inside, in its little glass dome, the {seedling:enter} seedling was reaching up for {seedling:live hold} the light. [whispers] You can't sleep either? said Astronomer. {astronomer:face happy} So she sat down beside it and told it a story about the stars: {seedling:pulse} which ones make a hunter, which a swan, which a great bear. {seedling:hearts} The seedling listened. {astronomer:face sleeping} And somewhere around the swan, Astronomer fell fast asleep, [softly] in the glow of the greenhouse, {greenhouse:glow} warm as a lamp.

es-ES.title: La luz del invernadero
es-ES.text: {canvas:nightfall 16s} La noche lunar era larga, {astronomer:enter} {astronomer:face sad} y Astrónoma no podía dormir. [sighs] {astronomer:shake} Probó a contar estrellas. Probó a contar cráteres. Entonces vio un brillo suave al otro lado de la llanura. {greenhouse:enter} Era el invernadero, iluminado de {greenhouse:live hold} violeta en la oscuridad. {astronomer:go to greenhouse} Se acercó de puntillas. Dentro, en su cúpula de cristal, el {seedling:enter} brote se estiraba hacia la {seedling:live hold} luz. [whispers] ¿Tú tampoco puedes dormir? dijo Astrónoma. {astronomer:face happy} Así que se sentó a su lado y le contó una historia sobre las estrellas: {seedling:pulse} cuáles forman un cazador, cuáles un cisne, cuáles una gran osa. {seedling:hearts} El brote escuchaba. {astronomer:face sleeping} Y más o menos por el cisne, Astrónoma se quedó dormida, [softly] al calor del invernadero, {greenhouse:glow} tibio como una lámpara.
